entities.title: Engine
entities.summary: The pure game: tuning, the seeded generator, deterministic maths, the simulation, recording and replay.
entities.purpose: Plays a game of Shatterbelt for one to nine ships, one fixed step of 1/60 s at a time, with no DOM, timers or randomness of its own, so the page, the tests and the Worker all get the same game from the same seed and controls.
boundaries: Only + − × ÷ and Math.sqrt: sine, cosine, arctangent and hypotenuse come from dmath.ts, and random numbers only from rng.ts.
Knows nothing of the page, the network, online play or the database; it lists what happened in each step in Game.events for the page to draw and sound.
